title: Your feedback on my Antigrav Racer was taken into account
author: EldrichArchive
selftext:
I wanted to take this opportunity to thank you for your very favorable, in many cases even positive comments on my retro anti-grav racer. I really didn't expect that. Thanks also for all the requests for a demo and the offers of help. But of course also for the criticism and the suggestions. Those really helped me a lot. 

Above all, I've already improved the sound and have even been offered help by a professional sound designer who has already worked on several well-known racing games. The game now also has a small physics engine that gives the vehicles a bit more "weight" and inertia. Of course, all of this is still very, very early, and a lot of it doesn't look the way it should yet. Ignore the textureless pterosaur, for instance ; )
